# vastdata_blob_expansion (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_blob_expansion" "example" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_name` (String) Getting list of objects by database_name
- `table_name` (String) Getting list of objects by table_name

### Optional

- `add_excessive_values_output` (Boolean) Whether the excessive-values output column is present in the target table
- `add_missing_values_output` (Boolean) Whether the missing-values output column is present in the target table
- `copy_source_column` (Boolean) Whether the source column is copied to the target table
- `expansion_format` (String) Expansion format
- `source_column_name` (String) Source column name
- `target_table_name` (String) Target table name for expanded data
- `tenant_id` (Number) Filter by tenant. Specify tenant ID.

### Read-Only

- `columns` (Attributes Set) List of expanded columns (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--columns))

<a id="nestedatt--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `columns`

Required:

- `database_name` (String) Name of the Database
- `name` (String) Name of the object
- `raw_field` (String) Raw description of column type
- `schema_name` (String) Name of the Schema
- `table_name` (String) Name of the Table
